rule.words: quoting individual papers is fine, we can just not republish papers. everything else can go public

embargo.scope: no per-paper record (coding files, rows of derived tables, audit rows, report sentences naming or describing a paper) of a paper in the human-coding set or the entry-audit sample until the human coding ends; aggregates over many papers are released
embargo.set_by: proposed by the roadmap workflow to keep the human coders blind to the model codings; confirmed by the PI on 2026-10-27 (keep until the human coding ends); quote volume accepted as is; data released under CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE section 1)

quoted_share.method: share of the words of each paper text (publisher XML text or pdftotext, counted separately) covered by verbatim runs of 12 words or more found anywhere in the release; an upper bound, since paraphrased fields that share 12 words with the paper count too
